news.text: Our paper “Content-related motor cortical representation during attempted handwriting” by Xinzhu Xiong，Xiaodi Wu，Xiaomeng Yang，Yueming Wang，Yu Qi was accepted at **Cell reports**! Congratulations to all the authors!

Our paper “Brain-writing-BERT for generalizable handwriting brain-computer interface” by Xiaomeng Yang, Jie Qin, Xinzhu Xiong, Junming Zhu, Jianmin Zhang, Yueming Wang, Yu Qi was published in **Communications Biology**! Congratulations to all the authors!

Our paper “Learning Neural State Transitions with a Graph-Augmented State-Space Model for High-Performance Neural Decoding” by Jie Yu, Lei Wang, Xiaomeng Yang, Xinzhu Xiong, Yueming Wang and Yu Qi was published in **Neurocomputing**! Congratulations to all the authors!

Our paper “Improving Neural Decoding Performance for Language BCIs by Explicitly Modeling Context-Induced Noise” by Yao Jia, Xianhan Tan, Binli Luo, Yueming Wang, and Yu Qi was accepted at **NeurIPS 2026**! Congratulations to all the authors!

paper_sharing.title: Joint-Space Empowerment for Dexterous Coordination in Tendon-Driven Hands
